nodes.label: Scans — Scapy raw-socket LAN scanner
nodes.rationale: Runs with network_mode: host plus NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW for real L2 access — Linux only.

nodes.label: Five-stage scan pipeline (ARP→ICMP→TCP→PTR→OUI)
nodes.rationale: Each stage catches hosts the previous missed: ARP for L2, ICMP ping-socket, TCP probes on configured ports, PTR reverse-DNS, then IEEE OUI vendor resolution. Persists open_ports and best-effort device_type per host.

nodes.label: Running scans (Quick scan, scans page, SSE stream, cancel)
nodes.rationale: Status lifecycle queued→running→completed/failed/cancelled with live SSE deltas, ETA and per-CIDR rate limit.

nodes.label: Scan targeting policy (scan_networks, excludes, only_configured, max_hosts)
nodes.rationale: Exclusions are enforced identically by the API route, the scheduler and the worker — a job that slips through one layer is stopped by the next.

nodes.label: Runtime-tunable scanner settings (Settings→Scanning)
nodes.rationale: Changes persist in app_settings, fall back to .env defaults and reach the worker within a minute — no restart needed.

hyperedges.label: Scan → reconcile → discovery inbox → address statuses
